mailwoman:sources.citation: The union of the Who's On First county records Carnot (1108759637), Amada-Gaza (1108759681), Gadzi (1108759717). Each sub-prefecture record is assigned to the prefecture that GeoNames files the populated places inside its boundary under, counted on 2026-11-28. For each of the 20 records, at least 96 percent of those places are under one prefecture.
